name: Camera Jitter BeG0nE
what: the stepped, jittery camera in VR: records when the head pose is read, the camera written and the picture sent
wire: copy jitterlog.h (native) or jitterlog.lua (REFramework) from the plugin's begone/camera-jitter/ into the mod; jl_init at load, jl_vr_on/jl_vr_off with the headset session, jl_pose_* where the head pose is read, jl_camera_* where the game camera takes it, jl_present per frame out
